item.title: Rust at Scale: An Added Layer of Security for WhatsApp
item.description:
📝 Rust is a memory safe language offering numerous security benefits. WhatsApp made a long-term bet to build that support. Given this success, Rust was fully rolled out to all WhatsApp users and many platforms: Android, iOS, Mac, Web, Wearables, and more.
🔗 Read more: https://engineering.fb.com/2026/01/27/security/rust-at-scale-security-whatsapp/
